title: Export training, game and scoped retrieval bundles
non_scope: No local or remote model weight training
No unilateral source corpus or pre-existing database mutation
No modification of SillyTavern runtime configuration
acceptance_criteria: Training parser/tokenizer, game loader and scoped retrieval smoke outputs are recorded separately.
All game references and media paths resolve; unknown geography remains unknown/proposed.
A revoked/disallowed fact is absent from positive exports across every consumer, not just ShareGPT.
description: Prove the dataset can be consumed by both model-adaptation tooling and game construction without mixing authority domains.
